q1_issues.issue: (Possession sk_performance_1 sk_students_1) for "the performance of students": the of-phrase names the nominalization's underlying subject, which the instruction set routes to the event noun's own subject role and explicitly bars from Possession ("Possession for an argument asserts a relation the text never states").

sk_subgroups_1 is minted but joined to nothing — the restriction "students in various subgroups" is silently dropped (no In / PartOf atom linking the students to the subgroups), and "various" is left unrecorded, widening the claim the sentence makes.
the flat (Member sk_state_1 deficient) asserts at strength 1.0 that the state is deficient, where the text reports only that the performance tagged it as such.

q2_gaps: object-complement labelling "V NP as ADJ" ("tagged the state as deficient"): the instruction set covers resultatives, depictives and finite-clause attitudes but never fixes whether a labelling/designation complement is a resultative (flat result state asserted) or a non-committal designation
discourse-initial adversative "But" — the instruction set itself says there is no in-sentence first endpoint, so the contrast relation has no carrier and is dropped
"various" as a plurality/diversity modifier: it is not a count phrase and not in the vague-quantity lexicon, so it has no licensed carrier
notes: The name/kind split on "the federal No Child Left Behind act" is handled exactly as the casing rule requires — the lowercase "act" is excluded from the Name string and emitted as the type atom, with "federal" as a separate property of the named individual. The framing PP "under <act>" correctly takes the preposition-named oblique Under rather than a location head.
